title: Pool Party
tagline: An institutional-grade crypto neobank abstracting DeFi complexity for non-crypto natives via USDC.

prizes.title: Build an Aqua App - Continuity Track

description:
Pool Party is an institutional-grade crypto neobank designed to bridge the gap between traditional finance and DeFi. We abstract all Web3 friction, such as seed phrases, gas fees, and complex bridges, allowing non-crypto native users and B2B treasuries to access high-yield on-chain strategies simply by depositing their local fiat.

Operating entirely in USDC to eliminate volatility fears, the platform functions as an intent-centric ecosystem. Users express their financial goals, and our hybrid architecture handles the rest. By combining an intuitive interface with the security of non-upgradable smart contracts, Pool Party safely brings traditional capital into the decentralized economy, acting as the ultimate "yield API" for the real world.
how_its_made:
We built Pool Party using a hybrid "Open Core" architecture that strictly separates cryptographic execution from off-chain intelligence. On-chain, we deployed highly deterministic, non-upgradable smart contract vaults that act as immutable security guardrails, ensuring 100% self-custody for the user. We heavily utilized Account Abstraction (ERC-4337) to sponsor gas and eliminate token friction, providing a seamless Web2 banking experience.

Off-chain, our proprietary back-end acts as an intent-centric solver. It monitors liquidity, calculates optimal routing, and feeds precise execution parameters to our contracts. A notable "hacky" and highly effective design choice was our isolated modular adapter pattern. This allows us to plug into any new DeFi protocol (like Aave or Uniswap) via peripheral contracts without ever needing to upgrade or risk the core user vault, ensuring continuous innovation with maximum security.
auto_summary: Pool Party combines a Next.js frontend with smart-contract vaults to route user funds into DeFi strategies and manage Aqua-based liquidity.
